service_name.description: Service name that will be returned in CheckMK response

time_range.description: ISO 8601 duration format used for both time range and granularity (e.g., PT1H, PT5M)

aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max
aggregation.description: Aggregation type applied to all metrics unless overridden

metadata_aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.
metadata_aggregation.description: Aggregation type for combining grouped metadata values. If not specified, defaults to 'aggregation' field. Applies to all metrics unless overridden per metric. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.

group_by_metadata.$comment: Available values: node, nodepool. Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.
group_by_metadata.description: Metadata field to group by. Supported values: node (default), nodepool. Applies to all metrics unless overridden per metric. Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.

type.$comment: Available values: not_ready_nodes, node_cpu_percent, node_memory_percent, node_disk_percent

time_range.description: Optional override for common time_range (used for both time range and granularity)

aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max

metadata_aggregation.$comment: Available values: average, sum, count, min, max. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.
metadata_aggregation.description: Optional override for common metadata_aggregation. If not specified, falls back to metric-level aggregation, then root-level metadata_aggregation, then root-level aggregation. Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.

group_by_metadata.$comment: Available values: node, nodepool. Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.
group_by_metadata.description: Optional override for common group_by_metadata. Supported values: node (default), nodepool. Required when filter_metadata_values or metadata_aggregation is defined.

filter_metadata_values.$comment: Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined. Array of metadata values to filter by. Supports wildcards (e.g., ['*'] for all values).
filter_metadata_values.description: Array of metadata values to filter by. Supports wildcards (e.g., ['*'] for all values). Can only be defined when group_by_metadata is defined.
